info.name: Superhuman Docs Admin Account Tables API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return in this query.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: An opaque token used to fetch the next page of results.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Determines how to sort the given objects.

params.name: tableTypes
params.description: Comma-separated list of table types to include in results. If omitted, includes both tables and views.

items.docs: Returns a list of tables in a document.

params.name: tableIdOrName
params.description: ID or name of the table. Names are discouraged because they're easily prone to being changed by users. If you're using a name, be sure to URI-encode it.

params.name: useUpdatedTableLayouts
params.description: Return "detail" and "form" for the `layout` field of detail and form layouts respectively (instead of "masterDetail" for both)

items.docs: Returns details about a specific table or view.
